Insightful Devotion +52: Passive: +52 Insight bonus to Positive (Healing) Spell Power.
Evocation Focus +5: +5 Equipment bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Fearsome: This item causes those who strike the user to be overcome with terror, as from the Fear spell.
